answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), verified through a fresh remote-attestation report and hardware-rooted keys. Reproducing zephyr, lotus, or opal identities cannot be achieved by duplicating a virtual machine: an attacker must purchase and provision distinct physical silicon capable of producing valid enclave evidence, making large-scale Sybil creation costly.
